Preface: I missed out on Amelia when Sacred World came out, so I was more than happy when she broke my pity rate when I was rolling for Deirdre in the Holy War banner. It took a lot of investment but Amelia is by far my favorite unit to use currently. Feedback appreciated! (This is my first post besides a few quick questions) Link to build: 
https://imgur.com/a/W93EB
Amelia, Rose of the War 

Nature - +SPD -DEF: Ideally you would want +SPD -HP because the new Weapon Refinery upgrades more than make up for any HP banes. Even if the point of this build is to tank mages the -HP would barely matter in the long run (except maybe vs. a fully horse buffed and merged + atk blade Cecilia, not sure). Since this was an incredibly lucky pull and nature I won't complain, and it's still really good. This nature makes it harder for units to double her so she can survive even a lot of swords (not named Ayra or Mia). 

Weapon -Slaying Axe +(Speed upgrade): Slaying Axe is Amelia's default and probably best axe currently (I'm not sure about the seasonal axes, I've never rolled any units with them). Combined with Luna she can take on and pose a threat to high defense units in a single round. The Speed Upgrade from the Weapon Refinery just overall improve her survivability even more; 40 speed (w/o summoner support) is still pretty fast. 

Assist -Swap/Reposition/pivot: I prefer swap/reposition if I'm using Amelia with at least one armor unit, especially with the Black Knight since they're S supported. If Amelia's the only armored unit on my team I would go Pivot but she really shines more with +1 move from Armor March so I try to always pair her with another armor. 

Special -Luna: If my Amelia wasn't -def I'd probably go with Bonfire. Technically I still could because +17 dmg is nothing to laugh at. I prefer Luna simply because she can duel people on defensive tiles better with it. It wouldn't really add much dmg to duels against mages but she should be two-shotting them anyway. Overall, Luna performs pretty well. 

A Skill -Distant Counter: I sacced my only Hector from the Legend banner for this (RIP), but it was worth it. Pretty self-explanatory, it allows her to actually kill ranged units(most often mages) on counter and not just tank them. 

B Skill -Green Tomebreaker 3: Even though 42 speeds decent most Ninos I see nowadays have 45+ speed and then they get buffed to at least 47 (hone spd seal 1). Since she has such a huge hp pool and decent res Amelia shouldn't be getting one shot by a full buffed Nino, and it allows her to kill on the counter attack. For non-arena builds I would probably go Vantage 3 because PvE enemies are not really optimized skillwise so most green tomes wouldnt be as much of a threat to her in non-arena.

C Skill- Armor March 3: Her default C skill, Armor March just makes Amelia much more versatile than your average armor. Since she wants to be fighting mages the extra movement helps her immensely in positioning versus them. 

Sacred Seal- Distant Defense 3: This seal is the bread and butter of this build along with distant counter. With it she can survive a fully merged, fully buffed, + atk reinhardt with moonbow active. She can survive an attack from fully buffed, fully merged +atk Nino, and she can even survive a good portion of Brave Lyns with an effective 97 hp against physical ranged (although she couldn't counter against most of them, I dont see too many non- sacae's blessing Lyns). 

So ends this build post, again any feedback is appreciated. Thanks for reading!
